d:
Bernie Sanders is throwing his weight behind Senator Chris Van Hollen's bid to oust Chuck Schumer as Senate Democratic leader. Accusing the Democratic establishment of serving billionaires and powerful special interests, Sanders is demanding a new direction for the party following its sweeping midterm victory. The leadership showdown could reshape the Democrats' agenda as they prepare to take control of the Senate.
